dataset.name: Dataset501_OLES3D9Organs
dataset.test_access_policy: No policy selection or tuning; final locked evaluation only

common_training.network_loss_augmentation_optimizer_sche: identical nnU-Net v2.8.1 plan and trainer lineage
common_training.loader_reproducibility: default nondeterministic workers; no bitwise reproducibility claim

guided_common.schedule: same seeded train-only case permutation and focus-organ rotation

B1.policy: online error pools; fixed-uniform organ allocation; pooled voxel-uniform error types

A1.policy: B1 plus focus-organ hard-Dice-deficit EMA allocation

P.policy: A1 plus organ-local raw-error-share EMA type allocation

evaluation.primary: case-first macro Dice over all 9 selected organs
evaluation.aggregation: mean over 9 organs within each case, then mean over cases
evaluation.ground_truth_empty: protocol violation because frozen eligible cohort requires all nine organs nonempty
evaluation.secondary: per-organ Dice and case-level paired differences; surface-metric definitions must be frozen before test evaluation

execution_order.stage_b: Run four additional seeds for all methods only after Stage A integrity checks
execution_order.cloud_policy: Deploy RunPod only for bounded smoke/main training/inference; stop between GPU-dependent gates

change_control: Any scientific change after this freeze requires a recorded reason, affected methods, rerun scope, and no held-out-test-driven selection
